Rule 7 explicit unavailable state: two browser-only behaviors are documented and surfaced — (a) document.title flashing has no RN equivalent, so the alternating prefix is exposed via getCriticalAlertFlashPrefix/subscribeCriticalAlertFlashPrefix with CRITICAL_ALERT_FLASH_TITLE_UNAVAILABLE_REASON; (b) the SSE 'alert' stream needs a host EventSource polyfill, exposed via getCriticalAlertFlashRealtimeStatus() ('subscribed' | 'unavailable') with CRITICAL_ALERT_FLASH_SSE_UNAVAILABLE_REASON. __resetCriticalAlertFlashForTests() mirrors titleStore.__resetTitleStoreForTests. No DOM, react-i18next, framer-motion, sseManager, Recharts, Leaflet, or web-UI imports were introduced — only react, react-native (AppState/AccessibilityInfo), and the native api/client + api/hooks/useSettings parity modules.
